facts.label: National Minimum Wage / National Living Wage
facts.value: 21 and over (National Living Wage): £12.71 per hour; 18 to 20: £10.85 per hour; under 18: £8 per hour; apprentice: £8 per hour
facts.note: Rates change on 1 April every year.
facts.sourceLabel: Source: GOV.UK - National Minimum Wage and National Living Wage rates

facts.label: Employee National Insurance (Class 1, category A)
facts.value: 0% from the lower earnings limit to the primary threshold; 8% on earnings above the primary threshold up to the upper earnings limit; 2% on earnings above the upper earnings limit
facts.note: Tax year 6 April 2026 to 5 April 2027. Standard category A employees.
facts.sourceLabel: Source: GOV.UK - Rates and thresholds for employers 2026 to 2027

headline.scope: category A; 8% between GBP 12,570 and 50,270, 2% above

facts.label: Employer National Insurance (Class 1, category A)
facts.value: 15% on earnings above the secondary threshold
facts.note: Tax year 2026 to 2027. Standard category A employees.
facts.sourceLabel: Source: GOV.UK - Rates and thresholds for employers 2026 to 2027

headline.scope: category A; above GBP 5,000/yr secondary threshold

facts.label: National Insurance thresholds (2026 to 2027)
facts.value: Primary threshold £242/week, £1,048/month, £12,570/year; secondary threshold £96/week, £417/month, £5,000/year; upper earnings limit £967/week, £4,189/month, £50,270/year; lower earnings limit £129/week, £559/month, £6,708/year
facts.sourceLabel: Source: GOV.UK - Rates and thresholds for employers 2026 to 2027

facts.label: Income tax bands (England, Wales and Northern Ireland)
facts.value: Personal Allowance up to £12,570 at 0%; basic rate £12,571 to £50,270 at 20%; higher rate £50,271 to £125,140 at 40%; additional rate over £125,140 at 45%
facts.note: Tax year 6 April 2026 to 5 April 2027. Scotland has different income tax bands and rates (not listed here).
facts.sourceLabel: Source: GOV.UK - Income Tax rates and Personal Allowances

facts.label: Statutory minimum wage (Mindestlohn)
facts.value: €13.90 gross per hour (from 1 January 2026); rising to €14.60 per hour in 2027
facts.note: Same page states the Minijob earnings limit is €603 a month in 2026 and €633 a month in 2027.
facts.sourceLabel: Source: Die Bundesregierung - 13,90 Euro: So hoch liegt der Mindestlohn 2026

facts.label: Employer social insurance contributions (headline rates)
facts.value: Health insurance 7.3% (half of the 14.6% general rate) plus half of the fund's additional rate (TK: 2.69%, so 1.345%; statutory average 2.9%); pension 9.3% (of 18.6%); unemployment 1.3% (of 2.6%); long-term care 1.8% (of 3.6%; Saxony differs)
facts.note: Rates for 2026. Cross-checked: SGB V s.241 (14.6%), RVBeitrSBek 2026 (18.6%), SGB III s.341 (2.6%), PBAV 2025 (3.6%), BMG notice BAnz AT 10.11.2025 B7 (2.9%); half-and-half split per SGB V s.249, SGB VI s.168, SGB III s.346, SGB XI s.58. Umlagen U1/U2 not covered.
facts.sourceLabel: Source: Techniker Krankenkasse (TK) - Beitragssaetze in der Sozialversicherung

headline.scope: TK fund (2.69% additional rate); Saxony differs

facts.label: Employee social insurance contributions (headline rates)
facts.value: Health 7.3% (half of 14.6%) plus half of the fund's additional rate (TK 2.69%: 1.345%; average 2.9%); pension 9.3%; unemployment 1.3%; long-term care 1.8% with 1 child, 2.4% childless, and 1.55% / 1.3% / 1.05% / 0.8% with 2 / 3 / 4 / 5+ children under 25; Saxony differs
facts.note: Rates for 2026. Care insurance: childless surcharge of 0.6 points is borne by the employee (SGB XI s.58); reduction of 0.25 points per child from the 2nd to 5th child under 25 (SGB XI s.55). Employer share stays 1.8% in the TK table.
facts.sourceLabel: Source: Techniker Krankenkasse (TK) - Beitragssaetze in der Sozialversicherung

facts.label: Social insurance contribution ceilings (Beitragsbemessungsgrenzen) 2026
facts.value: Pension and unemployment insurance: €8,450 per month (€101,400 per year); health and long-term care: €5,812.50 per month (€69,750 per year); knappschaftliche pension: €10,400 per month (€124,800 per year); compulsory-insurance threshold (health/care): €6,450 per month (€77,400 per year)
facts.note: Sozialversicherungsrechengrößen-Verordnung 2026 of 24 Nov 2025 (BGBl. 2025 I Nr. 278), in force 1 Jan 2026. Unemployment insurance uses the general pension ceiling (SGB III s.341(4)).
facts.sourceLabel: Source: Bundesministerium der Justiz - Gesetze im Internet, SVBezGrV 2026 (Sozialversicherungsrechengrößen-Verordnung 2026)

facts.label: Income tax schedule (Einkommensteuertarif) from assessment year 2026
facts.value: Up to €12,348 (Grundfreibetrag): 0; €12,349 to €17,799: progressive zone 1 (formula); €17,800 to €69,878: progressive zone 2 (formula); €69,879 to €277,825: 0.42 x income minus €11,135.63; from €277,826: 45% (0.45 x income minus €19,470.38; tax in euros)
facts.note: Formulas in s.32a(1) EStG: y = one ten-thousandth of taxable income above €12,348; z = one ten-thousandth above €17,799; x = taxable income rounded down to whole euros. Marginal rates of zones 1 and 2 are not stated in the statute. Soli and church tax not covered.
facts.sourceLabel: Source: Bundesministerium der Justiz - Gesetze im Internet, EStG s.32a Einkommensteuertarif

headline.scope: income tax only; Soli and church tax extra

facts.label: SMIC (salaire minimum de croissance)
facts.value: €12.31 gross per hour; €1,867.02 gross per month for a full-time (35-hour) job, from 1 June 2026 (previously €12.02 per hour / €1,823.03 per month)
facts.note: Revalued by 2.41% on 1 June 2026 (arrêté of 22 May 2026) per the source. Applies in mainland France and the overseas territories listed by the source; Mayotte has a lower rate (€9.56 per hour).
facts.sourceLabel: Source: Service-Public.gouv.fr - Salaire minimum : le Smic va augmenter le 1er juin

facts.label: Employer social security contributions (private sector, headline rates)
facts.value: Health/maternity/disability/death: reduced 7% or full 13%; old-age 2.11% on total pay plus 8.55% within the ceiling; family allowances: reduced 3.45% or full 5.25%; unemployment 4.00% and AGS 0.25%, both within €192,240 in 2026; CSA 0.30%; Fnal 0.10% (under 50 employees)
facts.note: Urssaf table "Taux patronaux applicables au secteur privé", updated 1 January 2026. Not covered: accident at work (rate notified by Carsat), versement mobilité, Fnal 0.50% (50+ employees), 0.016% social dialogue contribution, training levies.
facts.sourceLabel: Source: Urssaf - Taux de cotisations - Secteur prive

headline.notComparable: Rate depends on reduced or full rates, about 25.76% to 33.56%

facts.label: Employee social security contributions (private sector, headline rates)
facts.value: Old-age 0.40% on total pay plus 6.90% within the ceiling; CSG imposable 2.40% and CSG non imposable 6.80%, plus CRDS 0.50%, each on 98.25% of gross pay up to €192,240 in 2026; extra health contribution 1.30% in Haut-Rhin, Bas-Rhin and Moselle
facts.note: Urssaf table "Taux salariaux applicables au secteur privé", updated 1 January 2026. The table lists no employee unemployment contribution. CSG imposable / non imposable are the page's own labels.
facts.sourceLabel: Source: Urssaf - Taux de cotisations - Secteur prive

headline.notComparable: Contribution bases differ by component; there is no single rate

facts.label: Social security ceiling (PMSS / PASS) 2026
facts.value: €4,005 per month; €48,060 per year; €12,015 per quarter; €924 per week; €220 per day; €30 per hour (from 1 January 2026, up from €3,925 per month in 2025)
facts.note: Urssaf's 2026 table also quotes a separate limit of €192,240 for unemployment, AGS, CSG and CRDS bases.
facts.sourceLabel: Source: Service-Public.gouv.fr - Securite sociale : quel sera le plafond annuel en 2026 ?

facts.label: Income tax scale (barème de l'impot sur le revenu), per 1 part of family quotient
facts.note: Service-Public: the 2026 scale (applicable to 2025 income) is set by the finance law for 2026; page verified 15 April 2026. Household size changes the number of parts (quotient familial).
facts.sourceLabel: Source: Service-Public.gouv.fr - Quel est le bareme de l'impot sur le revenu ?

headline.scope: per tax part (quotient familial); 2026 scale on 2025 income

facts.label: Pay frequency
facts.value: Monthly: salary is obligatorily paid once a month (employees not on a monthly salary, such as seasonal, temporary or home workers, must be paid at least twice a month, at least every 15 days)
facts.sourceLabel: Source: Service-Public.gouv.fr - Paiement du salaire

facts.label: Statutory minimum hourly wage (wettelijk minimumuurloon)
facts.value: Age 21 and over: €14.99 gross per hour from 1 July 2026 (€14.71 from 1 January 2026); youth rates from 1 July 2026: age 20 €11.99, 19 €8.99, 18 €7.50, 17 €5.92, 16 €5.17, 15 €4.50 per hour
facts.note: The page also states there are no fixed minimum monthly, weekly or daily wages since 2024: those depend on hours worked. It lists amounts per 1 July 2026 and per 1 January 2026.
facts.sourceLabel: Source: Rijksoverheid.nl - Bedragen minimumloon 2026

facts.label: Employer payroll premiums (werknemersverzekeringen and Zvw) 2026
facts.value: AWf premium: low rate 2.74%, high rate 7.74%; differentiated Aof premium: low 6.27%, high 7.63%; differentiated Whk premium: see notification/decision per employer; Wko surcharge 0.50%; Ufo premium 0.68%; employer levy under the Health Insurance Act (werkgeversheffing Zvw) 6.10%
facts.note: From Belastingdienst tables 9 and 12 (Uitgave 3, 3 March 2026). Premiums apply to wages up to the maximum premium wage (see ssCeiling). Which low or high AWf/Aof rate applies is set out in Belastingdienst guidance and is not detailed here.
facts.sourceLabel: Source: Belastingdienst - Tarieven, bedragen en percentages loonheffingen vanaf 1 januari 2026

headline.notComparable: Rates differ by employer (sector premium); there is no single figure

facts.label: Employee national insurance premiums (volksverzekeringen) 2026
facts.value: Collected through the first wage-tax bracket for employees below AOW age: AOW premium 17.90%, Anw premium 0.10%, Wlz premium 9.65% (together with 8.10% wage tax = 35.75% on income up to €38,883)
facts.note: For employees at or above AOW age the first bracket is 17.85% (no AOW premium).
facts.sourceLabel: Source: Belastingdienst - Tarieven, bedragen en percentages loonheffingen vanaf 1 januari 2026

headline.notComparable: 27.65% applies only within the first income tax bracket

facts.label: Maximum premium wage (maximumpremieloon / maximumbijdrageloon) 2026
facts.value: €79,409.00 per year; €19,852.25 per quarter; €6,617.41 per month; €6,108.38 per 4 weeks; €1,527.09 per week; €305.41 per day (same maxima for employee insurances and the Health Insurance Act levy)
facts.sourceLabel: Source: Belastingdienst - Tarieven, bedragen en percentages loonheffingen vanaf 1 januari 2026

facts.label: Box 1 income tax / national insurance bands 2026 (below AOW age)
facts.note: First-bracket rate includes AOW, Anw and Wlz premiums. At AOW age (born 1946 or later) the first bracket is 17.85%; if born before 1946 it runs to €41,123 at 17.85%. Same rates in Belastingdienst loonheffingen 2026 table 1. Tax credits not covered.
facts.sourceLabel: Source: Belastingdienst - Voorlopige aanslag 2026: gebruikte tarieven en heffingskortingen

headline.scope: box 1; premiums included only in 1st bracket

facts.label: Salario Minimo Interprofesional (SMI)
facts.value: €40.70 per day or €1,221 per month (depending on whether pay is set by day or by month), annual figure €17,094, with effect from 1 January 2026
facts.note: Real Decreto 126/2026 of 18 Feb 2026 (BOE no. 44, 19 Feb 2026): +3.1% on 2025, effect from 1 Jan 2026. Art. 3.1 states an annual figure never below €17,094. The decree does not state a number of annual payments.
facts.sourceLabel: Source: Boletin Oficial del Estado - Real Decreto 126/2026, por el que se fija el salario minimo interprofesional para 2026

facts.label: Employer social security contribution rates (Regimen General)
facts.value: Common contingencies 23.60%; unemployment 5.50% (indefinite contracts and listed types) or 6.70% (fixed-term); FOGASA 0.20%; vocational training 0.60%; MEI (intergenerational equity mechanism) 0.75%; accident at work and occupational illness: per the premium tariff, employer only
facts.note: Orden PJC/297/2026 (BOE 31 Mar 2026), in force 1 Apr 2026 with effect from 1 Jan 2026. Temporary-incapacity rate for workers past retirement age: 1.55% (1.30% employer, 0.25% employee). Fixed-term contracts under 30 days: extra employer payment of €33.62.
facts.sourceLabel: Source: Boletín Oficial del Estado - Orden PJC/297/2026 (cotización a la Seguridad Social, desempleo, FOGASA y formación profesional 2026)

facts.label: Employee social security contribution rates (Regimen General)
facts.value: Common contingencies 4.70%; unemployment 1.55% (indefinite contracts and listed types) or 1.60% (fixed-term contracts); vocational training 0.10%; MEI 0.15%
facts.note: Overtime due to force majeure: employer 12.00%, employee 2.00% (total 14.00%); other overtime follows common-contingency rates (23.60% / 4.70%).
facts.sourceLabel: Source: Boletín Oficial del Estado - Orden PJC/297/2026 (cotización a la Seguridad Social, desempleo, FOGASA y formación profesional 2026)

facts.label: Contribution bases 2026 (monthly)
facts.value: Maximum base €5,101.20 per month in every group; minimum monthly base: Group 1 €1,989.30, Group 2 €1,649.70, Group 3 €1,435.20, Groups 4 to 7 €1,424.40; accident-at-work contribution base: minimum €1,424.40, maximum €5,101.20 per month
facts.note: Orden PJC/297/2026 arts. 2 and 3, from 1 Jan 2026. Groups 8 to 11 use daily bases (minimum €47.48, maximum €170.04 per day), not listed here.
facts.sourceLabel: Source: Boletín Oficial del Estado - Orden PJC/297/2026 (cotización a la Seguridad Social, desempleo, FOGASA y formación profesional 2026)

facts.label: Personal income tax (IRPF) withholding scale for employment income (art. 85)
facts.note: Scale of art. 85.1 of Real Decreto 439/2007 used to compute the withholding (cuota de retención), which is then reduced by the effect of the personal and family minimum. Consolidated text last updated 30 Sep 2026; art. 85.1 last amended by RD 899/2021.
facts.sourceLabel: Source: Boletín Oficial del Estado - Real Decreto 439/2007 (Reglamento del IRPF), art. 85, consolidated text

facts.label: Statutory national minimum wage
facts.value: No statutory national minimum wage (Eurostat, 1 July 2026); minimum pay is laid down by collective agreements for specific sectors
facts.note: Eurostat lists Italy with Denmark, Austria, Finland and Sweden as EU countries without a national minimum wage on 1 July 2026.
facts.sourceLabel: Source: Eurostat - Minimum wage statistics

facts.label: INPS contribution ceiling and floors 2026 (employees)
facts.value: Annual ceiling of the contribution and pensionable base €122,295 (for those first insured after 31 December 1995 or who opt for the contributive system); additional 1% employee contribution above €56,224 a year (€4,685 a month); minimum daily pay for contributions €58.13
facts.note: INPS circular no. 6 of 30 January 2026 on values for employees in private and public schemes. The ceiling is stated as €122,295.40, rounded to €122,295.
facts.sourceLabel: Source: INPS - Circolare n. 6 del 30 gennaio 2026: Determinazione per l'anno 2026 del limite minimo di retribuzione giornaliera e aggiornamento degli altri valori

facts.label: National income tax (IRPEF) rates 2026
facts.note: National IRPEF only. Regional and municipal surcharges depend on place of residence; deductions and tax credits are not included. For total income above €200,000 the benefit of the lower 33% rate is neutralised (Law 199/2025).
facts.sourceLabel: Source: Agenzia delle Entrate - Aliquote e calcolo dell'Irpef

headline.scope: national IRPEF only; regional/municipal surcharges extra

facts.label: Minimum monthly wage and minimum hourly rate
facts.value: 4,806 zł gross per month; minimum hourly rate 31.40 zł (from 1 January 2026)
facts.note: Set by the Council of Ministers regulation of 11 September 2025 (Dz.U. 2025 item 1242), in force from 1 January 2026.
facts.sourceLabel: Source: Dziennik Ustaw - Rozporządzenie Rady Ministrów z dnia 11 września 2025 r. w sprawie wysokości minimalnego wynagrodzenia za pracę (poz. 1242)

facts.label: Employer social security contributions (employees on an employment contract)
facts.value: Pension 9.76%; disability 6.50%; accident 0.67% to 3.33% (1.67% for small firms employing up to 9 people); Labour Fund 2.45%; Guaranteed Employee Benefits Fund (FGSP) 0.10%
facts.note: Rates as a percentage of gross pay, as listed on the page for an employee on the 2026 minimum wage. Pension and disability apply only up to the annual cap (see ssCeiling).
facts.sourceLabel: Source: Biznes.gov.pl - Ile kosztuje zatrudnienie pracownika na umowę o pracę

headline.notComparable: Accident premium varies, so the total is a range, not one rate

facts.label: Employee social security and health contributions
facts.value: Pension 9.76%; disability 1.50%; sickness 2.45%; health insurance 9%
facts.note: Percentages of gross pay as listed on the page. The three social contributions add up to 13.71% (computed). Health insurance is charged on pay after the employee's social contributions (page's worked example).
facts.sourceLabel: Source: Biznes.gov.pl - Ile kosztuje zatrudnienie pracownika na umowę o pracę

headline.notComparable: Pension, disability and sickness only; the 9% health part is not added

facts.label: Annual cap for pension and disability contributions 2026
facts.value: 282,600 zł per year (30 times the average monthly wage): no pension or disability contributions once annual pay exceeds this limit
facts.note: ZUS also gives 282,600 zł for 2026. Sickness, accident, Labour Fund and health contributions are not covered by this cap.
facts.sourceLabel: Source: Biznes.gov.pl - Ile kosztuje zatrudnienie pracownika na umowę o pracę

facts.label: Personal income tax scale (skala podatkowa) 2026
facts.value: 12% on annual taxable income up to 120,000 zł, less the amount decreasing tax of 3,600 zł; above 120,000 zł: 10,800 zł plus 32% of the excess
facts.note: The 3,600 zł reduction equals 12% of the 30,000 zł tax-free amount (per biznes.gov.pl). Health contributions are not deductible. Other regimes (flat 19%, lump sum) for business income are not covered.

bands.rate: 10,800 zł + 32% of the excess over 120,000 zł

facts.sourceLabel: Source: Ministerstwo Finansów (podatki.gov.pl) - Serwis o podatkach: Stawki i limity

headline.scope: PIT scale; the solidarity levy on very high income is extra

facts.label: Pay frequency
facts.value: At least once a month, on a fixed date set in advance, paid in arrears
facts.note: The employer must tell the employee in writing about the pay frequency within 7 days of concluding the employment contract.
facts.sourceLabel: Source: Biznes.gov.pl - Ile kosztuje zatrudnienie pracownika na umowę o pracę

facts.label: Guaranteed average minimum monthly income (GGMMI / GMMI, CAO no. 43)
facts.value: €2,233.61 gross per month for employees aged 18 and over, from 1 July 2026 (€2,189.81 from 1 April 2026)
facts.note: Set by collective labour agreement no. 43 of the National Labour Council, as amended by CAO no. 43/18 of 24 March 2026. The 1 July 2026 amount is the indexed figure after the pivot index was exceeded at the end of June 2026.
facts.sourceLabel: Source: Nationale Arbeidsraad (NAR) - Tabel cao-bedragen bijgewerkt op 01.07.2026 (cao nr. 43/18)

facts.label: Employer social security contributions (private sector, basic and wage moderation)
facts.value: Basic employer rate 24.92% of gross pay (private sector); plus wage moderation contribution of 5.67% of pay plus 5.67% of the employer contributions due; extra 1.60% (1.69% with wage moderation) for employers with on average 10 or more employees
facts.note: From the RSZ/NSSO DmfA instructions 2026/3. The tax shift lowers the basic rate to 19.88% for workers in categories 1 and 3 of the structural reduction. Not covered: manual-worker holiday contributions, special contributions, reductions.
facts.sourceLabel: Source: RSZ/NSSO (socialsecurity.be) - Administratieve instructies RSZ 2026/3: De socialezekerheidsbijdragen

headline.notComparable: Basic 24.92% excludes wage moderation and special contributions

facts.label: Employee social security contributions (worker share by branch)
facts.value: Pensions 7.50%; health care 3.55%; sickness and invalidity benefits 1.15%; unemployment 0.87% (these four shares add up to 13.07% of gross quarterly pay)
facts.note: Worker shares from the RSZ/NSSO instructions 2026/3, applied to gross quarterly pay. The 13.07% total is the sum of the four listed shares (computed here, not stated by the page).
facts.sourceLabel: Source: RSZ/NSSO (socialsecurity.be) - Administratieve instructies RSZ 2026/3: De socialezekerheidsbijdragen

facts.label: Federal personal income tax rates, income year 2026 (assessment year 2027)
facts.note: Indexed brackets (art. 130 WIB 92) for net taxable income. Municipal surcharges, the tax-free allowance and withholding scales are not included. Source is a professional publisher's table; FPS Finance pages could not be read.
facts.sourceLabel: Source: Wolters Kluwer - Overzicht van de belangrijkste fiscale grensbedragen in de personenbelasting (aanslagjaar 2027 - inkomsten 2026)

facts.label: Statutory minimum wage
facts.value: No statutory minimum wage; wages are often regulated by collective agreements
facts.note: The source page is the Swedish Work Environment Authority's guidance for posted workers.
facts.sourceLabel: Source: Swedish Work Environment Authority (Arbetsmiljöverket) - The rights of posted workers in Sweden

facts.label: Employer contributions (arbetsgivaravgifter) 2026
facts.value: Full rate 31.42% of pay (born 1959 or later): sickness 3.55%, parental 2.00%, old-age pension 10.21%, survivors 0.30%, labour market 2.64%, work injury 0.10%, general payroll 12.62%. Born 1938 to 1958: 10.21%. Born 1937 or earlier: none
facts.note: Temporary reduced rate 20.81% on pay up to 25,000 kr a month, for employees born 2003 to 2007 (the 2026 group), on pay from 1 April 2026 to 30 September 2027. Pay above 25,000 kr a month is charged at the full 31.42%.
facts.sourceLabel: Source: Skatteverket - Arbetsgivaravgifter

facts.label: Employee general pension fee (allmän pensionsavgift) 2026
facts.value: 7% of earned income, at most 47,100 kr a year; fully offset by a tax reduction of 100% of the fee
facts.note: The tax reduction cannot exceed the sum of municipal income tax, state income tax, property tax and property fee. The fee is shown on the final tax notice (slutskattebesked).
facts.sourceLabel: Source: Skatteverket - Belopp och procent inkomstår 2026

headline.notComparable: The nominal 7% is fully offset by a tax reduction

facts.label: Pension-qualifying income ceilings 2026
facts.value: Income ceiling for pension-qualifying income 673,038 kr (8.07 income base amounts); highest pension-qualifying income 625,500 kr (7.5 income base amounts); income base amount 83,400 kr
facts.note: Ceiling for building pension rights, not a cap on employer contributions. Price base amount 2026: 59,200 kr.
facts.sourceLabel: Source: Skatteverket - Belopp och procent inkomstår 2026

facts.label: Income tax 2026 (municipal and state), on taxable earned income
facts.value: Municipal income tax on all taxable income (average rate 32.38%, set by each municipality); plus 20% state income tax on taxable earned income above 643,000 kr
facts.note: Taxable income means earned income after the basic deduction (grundavdrag). The state tax threshold (skiktgräns) is 643,000 kr; the brytpunkt, before the basic deduction, is 660,400 kr (760,500 kr for those aged 66 or over at the start of the year).
facts.sourceLabel: Source: Skatteverket - Belopp och procent inkomstår 2026

headline.notComparable: State tax of 20% adds to municipal tax; no single national top rate

facts.label: National minimum wage
facts.value: €14.15 per hour for ages 20 and over; age 19: €12.74; age 18: €11.32; under 18: €9.91
facts.note: In force since 1 January 2026. Sub-minimum rates are 90%, 80% and 70% of the adult rate. Employees of a close relative and statutory apprentices are not entitled to the national minimum wage.
facts.sourceLabel: Source: Citizens Information - Minimum wage

facts.label: Employee PRSI (Class A, private sector)
facts.value: 0% if weekly earnings are €352 or less; 4.35% on all earnings if over €352 a week from 1 October 2026 (4.2% up to 30 September 2026); tapered credit of up to €12 a week on €352.01 to €424
facts.note: Class A only; other PRSI classes have different rates. The source says all PRSI contribution rates increase by 0.15% on 1 October 2026.
facts.sourceLabel: Source: Citizens Information - Paying social insurance (PRSI)

headline.scope: Class A; weekly earnings above EUR 352

facts.label: Employer PRSI (Class A, private sector)
facts.value: From 1 October 2026: 9.15% on weekly earnings up to €552; 11.4% if weekly earnings are above €552 (from 1 January 2026 to 30 September 2026: 9% and 11.25%)
facts.note: Class A only. The €552 weekly threshold applies from 1 January 2026. Other classes and low-earnings subclasses are not covered.
facts.sourceLabel: Source: Citizens Information - Paying social insurance (PRSI)

headline.scope: Class A; weekly earnings above EUR 552

facts.label: Income tax rate bands 2026 (single person, no qualifying children)
facts.value: 20% on the first €44,000; 40% on the balance
facts.note: Standard rate band for a single or widowed person without qualifying children. Other circumstances have different bands (for example married, one income: €53,000). Tax credits and USC are not included.
facts.sourceLabel: Source: Revenue Commissioners - Tax rates, bands and reliefs

headline.scope: single person; USC (top 8%) and PRSI extra

facts.label: Universal Social Charge (USC), standard rates 2026
facts.value: First €12,012 at 0.5%; next €16,688 at 2%; next €41,344 at 3%; balance at 8%
facts.note: Standard rates and thresholds. Cumulative thresholds (computed from the source): €28,700 and €70,044. Reduced rates apply to some people and are shown on a separate Revenue page.
facts.sourceLabel: Source: Revenue Commissioners - Standard rates and thresholds of USC

facts.label: Minimum wage (no statutory national minimum)
facts.value: Austria has no statutory minimum wage that applies to all employees; minimum wages are set mainly in sector collective agreements (Kollektivverträge), which cannot be undercut by contract. Most agreements provide at least €1,700 gross, 14 times a year
facts.note: About 95% of employees are covered by a collective agreement (over 800 agreements). Page last updated 12 August 2025. Rate depends on the applicable Kollektivvertrag.
facts.sourceLabel: Source: Sozialministerium (BMASGPK) - Mindestlohn in Österreich

facts.label: Employer social insurance contributions (ASVG, Arbeiter and Angestellte)
facts.value: Health 3.78%; accident 1.10%; pension 12.55%; unemployment 2.95%; IESG surcharge 0.10%; housing subsidy contribution 0.50% (Vienna 0.75%); plus employer pension-fund contribution (Betriebliche Vorsorge) 1.53% for contracts begun after 2002
facts.note: Official table of contribution values, status 1 January 2026 (version of 19 May 2026). Other employer charges (e.g. Dienstgeberbeitrag, Kommunalsteuer, Nachtschwerarbeit, SWF) are not covered here.
facts.sourceLabel: Source: Dachverband der österreichischen Sozialversicherung - Beitragsrechtliche Werte in der Sozialversicherung 2026

headline.scope: social insurance + IESG + housing + severance fund; excl. DB/DZ/KommSt

facts.label: Employee social insurance contributions (ASVG, Arbeiter and Angestellte)
facts.value: Health 3.87%; pension 10.25%; unemployment 2.95% (reduced for low earners: 0% up to €2,225, 1% to €2,427, 2% to €2,630 of the contribution base); Chamber of Labour levy 0.50%; housing subsidy contribution 0.50% (Vienna 0.75%)
facts.note: Official table, status 1 January 2026. Housing and Chamber of Labour contributions are listed in the same table. Special rules (e.g. older employees, freelance contracts, marginal employment) are not covered.
facts.sourceLabel: Source: Dachverband der österreichischen Sozialversicherung - Beitragsrechtliche Werte in der Sozialversicherung 2026

headline.scope: standard rates; reduced UI for low earners

facts.label: Maximum contribution base (Höchstbeitragsgrundlage) 2026
facts.value: €6,930 per month (€231 per day) for health, accident, pension, unemployment and IESG; annual cap for special payments (Sonderzahlungen) €13,860
facts.note: Official table, status 1 January 2026 (version of 19 May 2026). The same monthly maximum applies to the Chamber of Labour levy and the housing subsidy contribution.
facts.sourceLabel: Source: Dachverband der österreichischen Sozialversicherung - Beitragsrechtliche Werte in der Sozialversicherung 2026

facts.label: Income tax scale (Einkommensteuertarif) 2026
facts.note: Marginal rates per annual taxable income; thresholds raised by 1.733% (two-thirds of 2.6% inflation) for 2026, except the top band. Tax credits (Absetzbeträge) and Lohnsteuer withholding mechanics, 13th/14th salary tax rules are not covered.
facts.sourceLabel: Source: Bundesministerium für Finanzen (BMF) - Steuertarif

headline.scope: income over EUR 1m, temporary to 2029; else 50%

facts.label: Marginal employment threshold (Geringfügigkeitsgrenze) 2026
facts.value: €551.10 per month
facts.note: Indexation of the threshold was suspended for 2026 (para. 810(3) ASVG), per the source.
facts.sourceLabel: Source: Dachverband der österreichischen Sozialversicherung - Beitragsrechtliche Werte in der Sozialversicherung 2026

facts.label: Minimum wage (minimální mzda)
facts.value: 22,400 Kč per month or 134.40 Kč per hour for a 40-hour working week, from 1 January to 31 December 2026
facts.note: Pro-rated for shorter agreed weekly hours. Set by MPSV notice No. 356/2025 Sb. (coefficient 0.434 x forecast average wage of 51,497 Kč, rounded).
facts.sourceLabel: Source: MPSV - Minimální mzda

facts.label: Employer social security contributions
facts.value: Social security 24.8% of assessment base (sickness insurance 2.1%, pension insurance 21.5%, state employment policy contribution 1.2%)
facts.note: Higher employer rates: 27.8% for hazardous work (to rise to 28.8% in 2027 and 29.8% from 2028) and 29.8% for paramedics and company fire units. Employer discounts not covered. Health insurance is a separate fact.
facts.sourceLabel: Source: ČSSZ - Sazby pojistného

headline.notComparable: Health insurance (9% employer) is in a separate fact; social alone is not like-for-like

facts.label: Employee social security contributions
facts.value: Social security 7.1% of assessment base (sickness insurance 0.6%, pension insurance 6.5%)
facts.note: Health insurance is a separate fact. Discounts (e.g. for working pensioners) and other special cases are not covered.
facts.sourceLabel: Source: ČSSZ - Sazby pojistného

headline.notComparable: Health insurance (4.5% employee) is in a separate fact; social alone is not like-for-like

facts.label: Maximum assessment base for social security 2026
facts.value: 2,350,416 Kč per year (48 times the 2026 average wage of 48,967 Kč) for employees and self-employed
facts.note: Applies to social security contributions only. For health insurance see the separate assessment base fact.
facts.sourceLabel: Source: ČSSZ - Přehled nejdůležitějších údajů pro sociální zabezpečení v roce 2026

facts.label: Personal income tax rates 2026 (employment income)
facts.value: 15% on the part of the tax base up to 36 times the average wage (1,762,812 Kč a year); 23% on the part above that limit
facts.note: Monthly withholding advance uses 3 times the average wage (146,901 Kč): 15% up to it, 23% above it. Average wage 2026 is 48,967 Kč. Tax credits (slevy na dani) and deductions not covered.
facts.sourceLabel: Source: Finanční správa - Daň z příjmů: Zaměstnanci - zaměstnavatelé, Obecné informace

headline.scope: annual tax base above 36x average wage

facts.label: Health insurance premium (zdravotní pojištění), employees
facts.value: 13.5% of the assessment base: the employer pays two thirds (9%) and the employee one third (4.5%)
facts.note: The employer pays the whole premium to the health insurer and withholds the employee share from pay without consent. Due from the 1st to the 20th day of the following month.
facts.sourceLabel: Source: VZP ČR - 2.4. Plátce pojistného – zaměstnavatel

facts.label: Health insurance assessment base limits, employees
facts.value: Minimum base is the minimum wage (22,400 Kč a month from 1 January 2026), so the minimum premium is 3,024 Kč; there is no maximum assessment base (abolished)
facts.note: Exceptions apply to some employees, for example those for whom the state also pays the premium; the minimum is reduced in proportion for part-month employment.
facts.sourceLabel: Source: VZP ČR - Vyměřovací základ a výpočet pojistného

facts.label: Guaranteed minimum gross monthly wage (salariul de bază minim brut pe țară)
facts.value: 4,325 lei gross per month from 1 July 2026, for a normal working time of 166.667 hours a month on average (25.949 lei per hour)
facts.note: Government Decision (HG) 146/2026 of 12 March 2026, Monitorul Oficial no. 196 of 13 March 2026. The amount excludes bonuses and other additions. It replaces HG 1,506/2024.

headline.scope: normal working time, 166.667 hours a month

facts.sourceLabel: Source: Guvernul României (published by ANAF) - Hotărâre nr. 146/2026 pentru stabilirea salariului de bază minim brut pe țară garantat în plată

facts.label: Employer contributions on salaries
facts.value: Work insurance contribution (CAM) 2.25% of gross salary income (art. 220^3); employer social insurance (CAS) only in particular working conditions 4% or special working conditions 8% (art. 138)
facts.note: Codul fiscal, consolidated text on the ANAF site (last updated by OUG 38/2026). Calculated and paid by the 25th of the month after the salary month (art. 220^6). Exemptions and special sectors not covered.
facts.sourceLabel: Source: ANAF - Legea nr. 227/2015 privind Codul fiscal

headline.scope: standard conditions (CAM only); +4%/8% CAS in special conditions

facts.label: Employee contributions on salaries
facts.value: Social insurance (CAS) 25% and health insurance (CASS) 10% of gross salary income, calculated and withheld by the employer
facts.note: Codul fiscal art. 138(a), 156, 146 and 168: paid by the 25th of the month after the salary month. The monthly base is the gross salary income (art. 139, 157). Exemptions and special sectors not covered.
facts.sourceLabel: Source: ANAF - Legea nr. 227/2015 privind Codul fiscal

facts.label: Personal income tax on employment income
facts.value: Flat 10% income tax rate on taxable salary income
facts.note: Codul fiscal art. 64(1)(b): a single rate of 10% on taxable income from salaries and assimilated income. Personal deductions and the rules for other income types are not covered.
facts.sourceLabel: Source: ANAF - Legea nr. 227/2015 privind Codul fiscal

facts.label: Guaranteed minimum monthly remuneration (RMMG / salário mínimo nacional)
facts.value: €920 per month, with effect from 1 January 2026 (Decreto-Lei 139/2025 of 29 December; up 5.7%)
facts.note: Page updated 26 May 2026; the DGERT table lists the 2026 amount as €920.00 and a 5.7% increase. The page does not state the number of annual payments.
facts.sourceLabel: Source: DGERT - Retribuição mínima mensal garantida para 2026

facts.label: Employer social security contribution rate (Segurança Social)
facts.value: 23.75% of gross remuneration for profit-making employers; 22.3% for non-profit entities (IPSS and other entities)
facts.note: General rates ("de modo geral") for employees, per the gov.pt service page updated 7 September 2026; special regimes and reduced rates are not covered. Paid between the 10th and 25th of each month for the previous month.
facts.sourceLabel: Source: Instituto da Segurança Social (gov.pt) - Contribuições para a Segurança Social – pagar como trabalhador por conta de outrem

facts.label: Employee social security contribution rate (Segurança Social)
facts.value: 11% of gross remuneration (quotizações), included in the employer's monthly payment to Segurança Social
facts.note: General rate, per the gov.pt service page (updated 7 September 2026). Combined global rate is 34.75% for profit-making employers and 33.3% for non-profit entities.
facts.sourceLabel: Source: Instituto da Segurança Social (gov.pt) - Contribuições para a Segurança Social – pagar como trabalhador por conta de outrem

facts.label: Income tax (IRS) general rates, taxable income (Código do IRS art. 68)
facts.note: Wording of Lei 73-A/2025 of 30 December (the page lists earlier wording as in force until December 2025). The code also lists an average rate per band and splits income above €8,059 into two parts (art. 68(2)). Withholding tables not covered.
facts.sourceLabel: Source: Autoridade Tributária e Aduaneira (Portal das Finanças) - Código do IRS, Artigo 68.º Taxas gerais

headline.scope: IRS general scale; solidarity surcharge extra

facts.label: Minimum wage (no statutory national minimum)
facts.value: Denmark does not have a statutory minimum wage; pay is regulated by collective agreements or negotiated individually
facts.note: Written by the Ministry of Employment, updated 19 May 2026. The page says an individual agreement can stipulate a minimum wage for the sector and that unions publish annual wage statistics.
facts.sourceLabel: Source: Business in Denmark (Virk, Ministry of Employment) - Pay

facts.label: Employer ATP pension contribution (A-rate, monthly-paid employees)
facts.value: 198 kr per month (employee share 99 kr; total 297 kr) for employees working at least 117 hours a month; 132 kr for 78-116 hours; 66 kr for 39-77 hours; none below 39 hours
facts.note: ATP A-rate: fixed amounts, not a percentage of pay. Page updated 19 May 2026; a linked PDF is titled ATP rates valid from 1 January 2024. Public employers may use other rates (B to F). Other employer charges are not covered.
facts.sourceLabel: Source: Virk (Danish Business Authority) - Gældende satser for ATP-bidrag

headline.notComparable: Fixed ATP kroner amounts, not a percentage rate

facts.label: Employee labour market contribution (AM-bidrag)
facts.value: AM-bidrag 8% of pay, withheld by the employer; young employees are exempt (see note)
facts.note: From 1 January 2026 the employer does not report or pay AM-bidrag up to and including 31 December of the income year the employee turns 17. The employee ATP share is shown in the employer ATP fact.
facts.sourceLabel: Source: Skattestyrelsen (Skat.dk) - Beregn A-skat og am-bidrag af ansattes løn mm.

headline.notComparable: The 8% AM-bidrag is a labour-market tax, not social security

facts.label: State income tax rates 2026 (bundskat, mellemskat, topskat, toptopskat)
facts.value: Bundskat 12.01% on personal income above the personal allowance; mellemskat 7.5% over 641,200 kr; topskat 7.5% over 777,900 kr; toptopskat 5% over 2,592,700 kr (thresholds apply to personal income after AM-bidrag)
facts.note: Rates in the table are cumulative: each higher tax is added on top of the lower ones for income above its threshold. State taxes only: municipal tax and, for members of the Church of Denmark, church tax are added. Personal allowance amount not covered.
facts.sourceLabel: Source: Skattestyrelsen (Skat.dk) - Bundskat, mellemskat, topskat og toptopskat

headline.notComparable: State tax only; municipal tax adds to the top rate

facts.label: Pay frequency
facts.value: Monthly wages are paid monthly, in arrears; hourly, day and piecework wages are as a rule paid once or twice a month
facts.note: Paid to the employee's NemKonto unless otherwise agreed. Page written by the Ministry of Employment, updated 19 May 2026.
facts.sourceLabel: Source: Business in Denmark (Virk, Ministry of Employment) - Pay

facts.label: Average municipal and church tax 2026
facts.value: Average municipal tax 25.049% in 2026; average church tax 0.639% across all taxpayers (0.867% for members of the Church of Denmark)
facts.note: Skatteministeriet table of average municipal and church tax percentages; actual rates differ by municipality. The 0.867% is the average for the roughly 75% of taxpayers who are church members.
facts.sourceLabel: Source: Skatteministeriet - Kommuneskatter - gennemsnitsprocenter 2007-2026

facts.label: Minimum wage (legal minimums in nine sectors only)
facts.value: No set minimum wage in other sectors; legal minimum wages apply in nine sectors through generalised collective agreements (allmenngjøring), and wages elsewhere are agreed individually or in collective agreements
facts.note: Sector rates (e.g. construction, cleaning, hospitality) are on the source page. The page also presents a new sector, automotive, with minimums from 15 June 2026 (e.g. NOK 208 an hour for unskilled workers aged 18 or over).
facts.sourceLabel: Source: Arbeidstilsynet (Norwegian Labour Inspection Authority) - Minimum wage

facts.label: Employer's national insurance contribution (arbeidsgiveravgift) 2026, general trades
facts.value: Zone I 14.1%; Ia 10.6% (14.1% above the NOK 850,000 exemption amount); II 10.6%; III 6.4%; IV 5.1%; IVa 7.9%; V 0%
facts.note: The source says there were no changes to zones or rates from 2025 to 2026 (issued 6 January 2026). Different rules apply to central government, health trusts, sector-excluded activities and firms in financial difficulty. Rates vary by where the employer is located.
facts.sourceLabel: Source: Skatteetaten - Arbeidsgiveravgift til folketrygden for 2026

headline.notComparable: Rate varies by zone, from 0% to 14.1%

facts.label: Employee national insurance contribution (trygdeavgift) 2026
facts.value: 7.6% on wage income; lower limit NOK 99,650
facts.note: Other rates listed in the same table: fishing, trapping and childcare 7.6%; other business income 10.8%; pension income 5.1%. The source does not state an upper income limit.
facts.sourceLabel: Source: Skatteetaten - Forskuddsutskrivingen 2026

facts.label: Bracket tax (trinnskatt) 2026
facts.note: Applies to personal income (personinntekt) in addition to 22% tax on ordinary income and trygdeavgift. Personal allowance (class 1) NOK 114,540. Finnmark and parts of Troms have a lower fellesskatt rate (4.75% instead of 8.25%).
facts.sourceLabel: Source: Skatteetaten - Forskuddsutskrivingen 2026

headline.notComparable: Bracket tax only; the 22% general income tax is separate

facts.label: National Insurance basic amount (grunnbeløp, G)
facts.value: NOK 136,549 from 1 May 2026, up from NOK 130,160 (an increase of 4.91%)
facts.note: The source says the amount is formally adopted on 22 May 2026. Benefits adjusted through G rise by the same 4.91% from 1 May.
facts.sourceLabel: Source: Nav - Regulering av grunnbeløpet og pengestøtter fra 1. mai 2026

facts.label: Minimum wage (no statutory national minimum)
facts.value: There is no minimum wage law in Finland; minimum wages are set in the collective agreement of each sector, and universally binding agreements apply to all employers in the sector
facts.note: If no collective agreement applies, pay is agreed in the employment contract, or the Employment Contracts Act requires a usual and reasonable wage.
facts.sourceLabel: Source: Occupational Safety and Health Administration (tyosuojelu.fi) - Pay

facts.label: Employer statutory social insurance contributions 2026
facts.value: TyEL pension contribution averages 24.40% of pay, of which the employer share averages 17.10%; unemployment insurance 0.31% or 1.23% depending on total payroll; employer social security (health insurance) contribution 1.91%
facts.note: Contributions for 2026 per ETK leaflet; the 1.91% social security contribution is payable to the tax authority when the employee is insured in Finland. Workers' compensation and group life premiums vary by insurer and are not covered here.
facts.sourceLabel: Source: Finnish Centre for Pension (ETK) - Lakisääteiset sosiaalivakuutusmaksut Suomessa 2026

headline.scope: avg TyEL 17.10 + UI 0.31 + health 1.91; excl. accident/life

facts.label: Employee statutory social insurance contributions 2026
facts.value: TyEL pension 7.30% of pay and unemployment insurance 0.89% of pay, both withheld by the employer; the insured person's health insurance contribution is 1.98%
facts.note: Per ETK leaflet for 2026. The employer withholds the TyEL and unemployment shares from pay. The 1.98% (medical care and daily allowance contributions) is the insured person's health insurance contribution, payable to the tax authority.
facts.sourceLabel: Source: Finnish Centre for Pension (ETK) - Lakisääteiset sosiaalivakuutusmaksut Suomessa 2026

facts.label: State income tax scale on earned income 2026
facts.note: State tax only; the source says municipal and church tax are levied separately on earned income. Tax credits are not covered. The source gives tax at each lower limit (EUR 2,780.80; 4,794.80; 7,063.55; 11,053.55).
facts.sourceLabel: Source: Verohallinto (Finnish Tax Administration) - Ansiotulot

headline.notComparable: State tax only; municipal and church tax add to it

facts.label: Minimum wage (minimálbér) and guaranteed minimum wage (garantált bérminimum)
facts.value: Minimum wage HUF 322,800 a month (HUF 1,856 an hour) for full-time work; guaranteed minimum wage HUF 373,200 a month (HUF 2,145 an hour) for jobs requiring at least secondary education or qualification
facts.note: Government Decree 426/2025 (XII. 23.), applicable from 1 January 2026. Weekly and daily rates are also set: HUF 74,210 and 14,850 (minimum); HUF 85,800 and 17,160 (guaranteed).
facts.sourceLabel: Source: Nemzeti Jogszabálytár (Magyar Közlöny) - 426/2025. (XII. 23.) Korm. rendelet a kötelező legkisebb munkabér (minimálbér) és a garantált bérminimum megállapításáról

facts.label: Social contribution tax (szociális hozzájárulási adó) paid by the employer
facts.value: 13% of the tax base
facts.note: NAV information booklet published 16 January 2026: the rate of the tax is 13% of the tax base. Other rates apply to some items (for example long-term investment contract income at 0%, 8% or 13%). Tax base rules, exemptions and other employer charges are not covered.
facts.sourceLabel: Source: NAV (Nemzeti Adó- és Vámhivatal) - A szociális hozzájárulási adó (információs füzet)

headline.scope: social contribution tax only; other employer levies not covered

facts.label: Social security contribution paid by the insured person (járulék)
facts.value: Társadalombiztosítási járulék 18.5%; the 10% pension contribution is payable only for jobseekers receiving allowance and by church legal entities for church personnel in church service
facts.note: NAV page "Fizetendő járulékok 2026. január 1-jétől" (dated 5 January 2026) lists the contributions payable by the insured person from 1 July 2020. Contribution base and special cases are not covered.
facts.sourceLabel: Source: NAV (Nemzeti Adó- és Vámhivatal) - Fizetendő járulékok 2026. január 1-jétől

headline.scope: social security contribution (TB járulék) on gross pay

facts.label: Personal income tax (szja) rate
facts.value: 15% of the tax base, unless the Act provides otherwise
facts.note: Szja Act (1995. évi CXVII.) section 8 (1), consolidated text on the Nemzeti Jogszabálytár dated 1 October 2026. NAV's rate table also lists 15% from 2016 for the consolidated tax base. Allowances and credits are not covered.
facts.sourceLabel: Source: Nemzeti Jogszabálytár - 1995. évi CXVII. törvény a személyi jövedelemadóról

facts.label: Statutory minimum monthly salary (white-collar) and daily wage (blue-collar)
facts.value: EUR 920.00 a month for white-collar workers and EUR 41.09 a day for blue-collar workers, from 1 April 2026 (Ministerial Decision 8934/27.3.2026, Gazette B 1759)
facts.note: Seniority increments: white-collar 10% every three years up to 30% (nine years); blue-collar 5% every three years up to 30% (eighteen years). Contracts may not provide pay below the statutory minimum.
facts.sourceLabel: Source: Ministry of Labour and Social Affairs (Greece) - Minimum Wage

facts.label: Employer social security contribution rate (e-EFKA), coverage package 101
facts.value: 21.79% of earnings (package code 101 "ΜΙΚΤΑ, ΙΚΑ-ΤΕΑΜ"), valid from 1 January 2025
facts.note: Table of coverage packages (ΚΠΚ) in e-EFKA circular 38/2024: package 101 shows insured 13.37%, employer 21.79%, total 35.16%. Other packages differ (e.g. 102: employer 22.79%).
facts.sourceLabel: Source: e-EFKA - Εγκύκλιος 38/2024, Μείωση ασφαλιστικών εισφορών κλάδου υγειονομικής περίθαλψης από 01.01.2025 (πίνακας ΚΠΚ)

facts.label: Employee social security contribution rate (e-EFKA), coverage package 101
facts.value: 13.37% of earnings (package code 101 "ΜΙΚΤΑ, ΙΚΑ-ΤΕΑΜ"), valid from 1 January 2025
facts.note: Same table of coverage packages (ΚΠΚ) in e-EFKA circular 38/2024. Other packages differ (e.g. 105: insured 16.82%; 103: 10.37%).
facts.sourceLabel: Source: e-EFKA - Εγκύκλιος 38/2024, Μείωση ασφαλιστικών εισφορών κλάδου υγειονομικής περίθαλψης από 01.01.2025 (πίνακας ΚΠΚ)

facts.label: Maximum insurable monthly earnings (EFKA)
facts.value: EUR 7,761.94 a month from 1 January 2026
facts.note: Set by Ministry of Labour document Δ.15/Δ΄/1865/23-01-2026 (Gazette B 318/29-01-2026), per e-EFKA. The minimum monthly base for full-time employees is EUR 920.00 from 1 April 2026.
facts.sourceLabel: Source: e-EFKA - Γενικές ερωτήσεις (Μισθωτοί)

facts.label: Income tax scale on employment and pension income, tax years 2026 onwards (base scale)
facts.value: 9% on the first EUR 10,000; 20% on the next 10,000; 26% on the next 10,000; 34% on the next 10,000; 39% on 40,001-60,000; 44% above EUR 60,000
facts.note: Base rates of the first column; the source lists lower rates by number of dependent children and for young people (up to 25: zero up to EUR 20,000; 26 to 30: 9% on the second band). Tax credits are not covered.
facts.sourceLabel: Source: Ministry of Economy and Finance (Greece) - Income Taxation

facts.label: Cantonal minimum wage: Geneva (gross hourly)
facts.value: CHF 24.59 gross per hour from 1 January 2026 (up from CHF 24.48); agriculture and floriculture CHF 18.07 per hour
facts.note: Canton of Geneva only; adjusted yearly to the consumer price index. Minimum wages of other cantons and sector agreements are not covered here.
facts.sourceLabel: Source: République et canton de Genève - Le salaire minimum genevois 2026 s'établira à 24.59 fr. de l'heure

facts.label: Employer contributions AHV/IV/EO and ALV (first pillar)
facts.value: AHV 4.35% + IV 0.7% + EO 0.25% = 5.3% of income; ALV (unemployment) 1.1% on income parts up to CHF 148,200
facts.note: BSV table, status 1 January 2026. Occupational pension (BVG) rates vary by pension fund; accident premiums are set by each insurer; family allowance contributions are shown as a range (1.025 to 2.75% of wages outside agriculture). None of these is covered.
facts.sourceLabel: Source: Bundesamt für Sozialversicherungen (BSV) - Schweizerische Sozialversicherungen, synoptische Tabelle der anwendbaren Beitrags- und Prämiensätze (Stand 1.1.2026)

headline.notComparable: Covers old-age and unemployment insurance only, not pension or accident cover

facts.label: Employee contributions AHV/IV/EO and ALV (first pillar)
facts.value: AHV 4.35% + IV 0.7% + EO 0.25% = 5.3% of income; ALV (unemployment) 1.1% on income parts up to CHF 148,200
facts.note: Same rates as the employer row of the BSV table, status 1 January 2026 (total with employer: 10.6% AHV/IV/EO and 2.2% ALV). Pension fund and accident insurance contributions are not covered.
facts.sourceLabel: Source: Bundesamt für Sozialversicherungen (BSV) - Schweizerische Sozialversicherungen, synoptische Tabelle der anwendbaren Beitrags- und Prämiensätze (Stand 1.1.2026)

headline.notComparable: Covers old-age and unemployment insurance only, not pension or accident cover

facts.label: ALV (unemployment insurance) income ceiling
facts.value: CHF 148,200: ALV 1.1% each for employer and employee applies to income parts up to this amount
facts.note: The BSV table shows AHV/IV/EO contributions as a percentage of income without an income ceiling. The same table gives CHF 148,200 per year as the maximum insured earnings for accident insurance.
facts.sourceLabel: Source: Bundesamt für Sozialversicherungen (BSV) - Schweizerische Sozialversicherungen, synoptische Tabelle der anwendbaren Beitrags- und Prämiensätze (Stand 1.1.2026)

facts.label: Minimum occupational pension (BVG) age credits
facts.value: 7% (age 25-34), 10% (35-44), 15% (45-54), 18% (55-65) of the coordinated salary, which lies between CHF 26,460 and CHF 90,720
facts.note: Minimum rates; contribution rates vary from one pension fund to another. The employer's contribution must be at least as high as the employees' (BSV table, status 1 January 2026).
facts.sourceLabel: Source: Bundesamt für Sozialversicherungen (BSV) - Schweizerische Sozialversicherungen, synoptische Tabelle der anwendbaren Beitrags- und Prämiensätze (Stand 1.1.2026)

facts.label: Direct federal tax (direkte Bundessteuer) tariff 2026, single persons
facts.value: Annual tax for single persons: CHF 400.80 on taxable income of CHF 50,000; CHF 2,684.35 on CHF 100,000; above the last table row (CHF 950,000) a uniform 11.5%
facts.note: Form 58c, ESTV tariff 2026 (ESTV / DVS 01.2026), column "Alleinstehende". A separate column applies to married couples and single-parent families, with tax reduced by CHF 263 per child or supported person. Income is rounded down to CHF 100. Cantonal and municipal taxes are not covered.
facts.sourceLabel: Source: Eidgenössische Steuerverwaltung (ESTV) - Tarife 2026, Tabelle für die Berechnung der direkten Bundessteuer der natürlichen Personen (Form. 58c)
